text.en: The further a Void orb falls, the more powerful its detonation becomes.
The further a Void orb falls, the more powerful its detonation becomes.

Void Orbs linearly increase in damage as they fall, dealing up to <pve 182.5% /> <pvp [47.7%] /> bonus damage after 3 seconds of being airborne. 

Maximum damage is indicated by <yellow critical /> numbers.
